'''Draba''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
During the time of the Galactic Civil War, Draba invested a lot of money in resources in getting [[Zerex]], the [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Adinorr]], into her debt. Draba also once had a falling out with the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Solvek]] and tried to feed him to a [[Nexu/Legends|nexu]]. Solvek later tried to take a job from Zerex, but when the governor learned of Draba's grudge against the hunter, he had Solvek arrested and sent to the [[Spice mines of Kessel/Legends|Spice Mines of Kessel]]. However, when Zerex gained a promotion to become the [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] of the [[Meridian sector/Legends|Meridian sector]], he broke off all of his ties to Draba, as he believed that it would be inappropriate for him to be seen socializing with a known criminal. However, Draba was angered by his betrayal, so hired a group of agents to blackmail Zerex into honoring his commitments to her.<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />

A short time afterward, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] bureaucrat [[Narp Pilyev]] offered to sell Draba some valuable [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] documents that he had stolen. However, he wanted to sell them at a high price and told the Hutt that he would offer the documents to another buyer if she did not meet his price within five days. Draba responded by hiring a group of agents to infiltrate Pilyev's apartment on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], and steal the documents.<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />

Within months of his promotion to Moff, Zerex secured another promotion, to the position of [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]]. Draba believed that the promotion put Zerex in a position where he could threaten her and possibly even have arrested. As a result, she didn't want to allow the promotion to take place, so she hired some agents to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] Zerex before his inauguration could occur.<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />

At some point, the [[Clawdite/Legends|Clawdite]] thief [[Pol Virten]] stole a broken [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed lightsaber]] and a fragment of a [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocron]] from Draba. In response, the Hutt hired some agents to capture the thief.<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />
